title: Arrow keys
drDigitalIntro:
The four arrow keys move you around — no mouse needed.
• Press the right or down arrow to move to the next item.
• Press the left or up arrow to move back.
• Press Enter to open whichever item is highlighted.
• Arrow keys work in file lists, menus, web pages, and many other places.
• The Files app gets its own unit later (Unit 3) — for now, just follow the glow and drive it with the keyboard.

playgroundTask.goal: Navigate a file list using only the arrow keys

steps.say: Press the right or down arrow key until GroceryList.txt is highlighted.
Now press Enter to open it.

drDigitalSuccess: Arrow keys to move, Enter to open. The mouse never came into it.
drDigitalHint: Click inside the file list first so it can receive key presses, then press the right or down arrow key to move the highlight. Keep pressing until GroceryList.txt is highlighted, then press Enter.
